contentText:
Chris Perfetti, Richard Gadd, Brooks Nader, Shabana Azeez, Gerran Howell, Haley Kalil and more play pass the mic on the 2026 Emmys red carpet.

Shabana Azeez
First of all you are a snack.

Krys Marshall
Ooh!

Chris Perfetti
Oh man.

Richard Gadd
Oh that’s a really good question. The role that somebody else has played this year that you would most like to play yourself.

Joy Taylor
I mean, I really love Matthew Rhys, but I don’t know that I could be him. But I aspire. How are you keeping cool today?

Peter Krause
I’m not. I’m just sweating. If you could be on any television series from the past, what would it be?

‘Gilligan’s Island’ in a little top tie up with a little booty shorts, like Marianne. If you could work with anybody who’s now gone on, passed on, who would that be?

Our boy Tim Curry, who I loved so much, such an icon. R.I.P. my dude. What’s the first thing you’re gonna do when you take off what you’re wearing today.

Thank you, Chris, for that question. Put on my next outfit, which is a deeply uninteresting take. You are a snack, but if you could be an actual food snack, what snack would you be?

Jeff Hiller
I’d probably be a Nutty Buddy. I don’t want to explain why. What superpower do you want?

Geran Howell
I think it’s got to be flight. I’m always suspicious if people say “I want to be invisible.” I’m always like, it’s kind of weird. Favorite British snack?
